title: MPC Controller
text: Simulate model predictive controller, 21 inputs, 7 outputs, {Block data type} sets data type of manipulated variables; {MPC Controller} sets the controller object mpc, {Initial Controller State} sets the initial state mpcstate, {Design} sets the interactively design controller, {Review}, {Measured disturbance} adds measured disturbance input port, {External manipulated variable} adds external manipulated variable input, {Targets for manipulated variables} adds manipulated variable target input port, {Optimal cost} adds optimal cost output port, {Optimization status} adds optimization status output port, {Estimated controller states} adds estimated states output port, {Optimal control sequence} adds optimal control sequence output port, {Optimal state sequence} adds optimal state sequence output port, {Optimal output sequence} adds optimal output sequence output port, {Use custom state estimation instead of using the built-in Kalman filter} uses custom state estimate input port, {Lower OV limits} adds minimum OV constraint input port, {Upper OV limits} adds maximum OV constraint input port, {Lower MV limits} adds minimum MV constraint input port, {Upper MV limits} adds maximum MV constraint input port, {Custom constraints} adds input ports for mixed input/output linear constraints, {OV weights} adds OV tuning weights input port, {MV weights} adds MV tuning weights input port, {MVRate weights} adds MV rate tuning weights input port, {Slack variable weight} adds ECR tuning weight input port, {Adjust prediction horizon and control horizon at run time} adds horizon input ports, {Maximum prediction horizon} adds horizon input ports, {Sample time} sets the default block sample time, {Prediction horizon} sets the default prediction horizon, {Number of manipulated variables} sets the default number of manipulated variables, {Number of measured disturbances} sets the default number of measured disturbances, {Number of unmeasured disturbances} sets the default number of unmeasured disturbances, {Number of measured outputs} sets the default number of measured outputs, {Number of unmeasured outputs} sets the default number of unmeasured outputs, {Inherit sample time} sets the inherit block sample time from parent and {Use external signal to enable or disable optimization} adds switch input port. Values come from the instance.
